home.faqQ1: How do I apply for a job on Pracuj.be?
home.faqA1: The job page shows how to contact the employer: a website, email address or phone number. You send your application directly to the employer.
home.faqQ2: Is Pracuj.be free for job seekers?
home.faqA2: Yes. Browsing jobs, an account and saved jobs and searches are free for job seekers.
home.faqQ3: What languages does the platform support?
home.faqA3: You can use Pracuj.be in Polish, Dutch, French and English. The text of a job offer is in the language the employer wrote it in.
home.faqQ4: Do I have to speak Dutch or French?
home.faqA4: Not always. Some jobs do not require the local language. Use the “No language required” filter to see them.
home.faqQ5: How do I contact an employer?
home.faqA5: Each job shows the contact method chosen by the employer. You agree on the next steps directly with the employer.

employers.title: Post a job in Belgium
employers.intro: Pracuj.be is a job ad portal for Belgium. You publish a job and job seekers contact you directly, the way you describe in the ad.
employers.ctaLogin: Already have an account? Log in
employers.photoDisclaimer: Illustrative photo — does not show a specific employer.

employers.freeDesc: At this stage of development, Pracuj.be does not charge for a company account or for publishing job offers. We do not sell packages or subscriptions.

help.title: Help
help.intro: Answers to the most common questions about how Pracuj.be works. If you can’t find an answer here, write to us through the contact form.

howToApply.q: How do I apply for a job?
howToApply.a: The job page shows how to contact the employer: a website, email address or phone number. You send your application directly to the employer, not through Pracuj.be.

dataSharing.q: Does Pracuj.be pass my data on to employers?
dataSharing.a: No. The portal does not send employers any data from your account. An employer only receives what you send yourself when you contact them the way the job describes.

account.a: You do not need an account to browse jobs. After you <register>sign up</register> you can save jobs and searches and turn on email alerts for new jobs.

alerts.q: How do I get alerts about new jobs?
alerts.a: On the <jobs>job list</jobs>, set your filters and choose “Save search”. In the candidate panel you turn on email alerts for it — daily or weekly.

data.q: How do I download my data or delete my account?
data.a: In the candidate panel settings, in the “Your data and account” section, you can download your data as a JSON file or delete your account.

free.q: How much does it cost to publish jobs?
free.a: At this stage Pracuj.be is free for employers. The portal does not sell packages or paid job postings.

verification.a: Verification means a portal administrator has checked the company’s registration details, such as its name and VAT/KBO number. It is not a rating of the company or its jobs. Only verified companies can publish jobs; you see the status in the employer panel. If your company is rejected, you see the reason and can choose “Send for verification again”.

drafts.q: Can I prepare a job before verification?
drafts.a: Yes. The job wizard saves a draft after each step. You publish it once your company is verified.

team.a: The company owner or admin invites team members by email address in the employer panel and gives them a role.

candidateContact.a: In the job you give at least one contact method: a website, email address or phone number. Candidates contact you directly. Read more on the <employer>For employers</employer> page.

languages.q: Which languages is the site available in?
languages.a: The site is available in Polish, Dutch, French and English. You can change the language in the header or the footer.

emailLanguage.q: In which language will I receive emails?
emailLanguage.a: Emails about your account are sent in the language set on your account.

noEmail.q: I am not receiving emails from the site. What should I do?
noEmail.a: Check your spam folder and that your email address is correct. If the message still doesn’t arrive, write to us through the contact form.

suspicious.q: A job looks suspicious. What should I do?
suspicious.a: On the job page, choose “Report this job” or “Report this company”. You can send a report without an account and you get a case number to check its status.
